acquisitionChannel.label: Acquisition channels
acquisitionChannel.description: Where a person came from, as a classifier or a person recorded it. Fills firstTouchChannel and latestTouchChannel, and is the set a session-grain channel should reuse. Deliberately coarse. ai_assistant is the value the set exists for: a visit referred by an AI assistant's own domain. A search engine's AI overview is not one either: the visit comes from a results page, so it has its own value, ai_overview, which no source fills yet. Every vendor draws these lines its own way, so a mapped value is a derivation and says whose rule made it.
acquisitionChannel.source: XEO CRM pipeline research report, 2026-11-10 · ai_assistant is evidenced by two vendors' classifiers (one CRM's traffic-source value, one analytics tool's default channel). The other values are a neutral set inferred for XEO from the channel lists those classifiers publish; no vendor's list is adopted

concepts.label: AI assistant
concepts.definition: Arrived from an AI assistant's own domain or app: a chat or answer product, not a search engine's results page

concepts.label: AI overview
concepts.definition: Arrived from an AI-generated overview on a search engine's results page
concepts.editorialNote: Kept apart from ai_assistant and from organic_search by decision (2026-11-11): the visit comes from a results page, so it is not an assistant's, and it was sent by a generated answer, so it is not an ordinary result. No source read reports it separately, and no vendor field in mappings/ carries it, so the value has no filling yet. It is declared so that it has a home when a tool reports it.

concepts.label: Direct
concepts.definition: Arrived with no referrer: typed, bookmarked, or stripped

concepts.label: Email
concepts.definition: Arrived from a link in an email

concepts.label: Offline
concepts.definition: Entered other than by a tracked visit: an import, an event, a call, manual entry

concepts.label: Organic search
concepts.definition: Arrived from an unpaid search result

concepts.label: Organic social
concepts.definition: Arrived from an unpaid social post or profile

concepts.label: Other
concepts.definition: Tracked, and matching none of the above: an untyped campaign

concepts.label: Paid search
concepts.definition: Arrived from a search advertisement

concepts.label: Paid social
concepts.definition: Arrived from a social advertisement

concepts.label: Referral
concepts.definition: Arrived from a link on another site that is not search, social or an AI assistant

additivity.label: Additivity
additivity.description: Whether readings of a Metric may be added together across windows, pages or terms. The rule that keeps an Objective from being read as the sum of its Outcomes.
additivity.source: XEO metrics and KPIs research report, 2026-11-10 · dbt (non_additive_dimension), Cube (count_distinct_approx), LookML (sum_distinct), Matomo (sum_daily_nb_uniq_visitors), GSC (aggregationType)

concepts.label: Additive
concepts.definition: Readings may be summed across any dimension, provided they share an aggregationBasis

concepts.label: Non-additive
concepts.definition: Readings are never summed. A ratio, an average, a rank or a distinct count over a union is recomputed from its parts

concepts.label: Semi-additive
concepts.definition: Readings may be summed across some dimensions and not others; typically not across time

aggregation.label: Aggregations
aggregation.description: How a simple Metric reduces the values of the slot it reads to one number over a window. Named for the operation, never for a library's function.
aggregation.source: XEO metrics and KPIs research report, 2026-11-10 · the aggregation types common to dbt (agg), Cube and LookML (type) and Malloy

concepts.label: Count
concepts.definition: The number of records

concepts.label: Distinct count
concepts.definition: The number of different values. Not additive across windows: a visitor seen on two days is one visitor

concepts.label: Last
concepts.definition: The most recent value in the window, as for a rank read from the latest snapshot

concepts.label: Maximum
concepts.definition: The largest value

concepts.label: Mean
concepts.definition: The arithmetic mean of the values

concepts.label: Median
concepts.definition: The middle value

concepts.label: Minimum
concepts.definition: The smallest value

concepts.label: Percentile
concepts.definition: The value below which a stated share of the values fall; the share is percentileValue

concepts.label: Sum
concepts.definition: The values added together

concepts.label: Weighted mean
concepts.definition: The mean of the values, each weighted by a stated quantity (an average position weighted by impressions)

aggregationBasis.label: Aggregation bases
aggregationBasis.description: How a source deduplicated before it returned a value. One source documents the choice, and there the same field gives two different counts under the two bases.
aggregationBasis.source: XEO metrics and KPIs research report, 2026-11-10 · Google Search Console Search Analytics API (aggregationType: auto, byPage, byProperty), neutral spelling

concepts.label: Source's choice
concepts.definition: The source chose the basis from the request. Record which it chose where it says

concepts.label: By page
concepts.definition: Counted once per page: each of the site's pages in a result counts

concepts.label: By property
concepts.definition: Counted once per site: several of the site's pages in one result count as one impression

algorithm.label: Algorithms
algorithm.description: The methods an AlgorithmRun can execute. Each concept names the published algorithm, not a library's procedure: the implementing library and its version are parameters of the run. Three families: centrality (pagerank, betweenness, degree), community detection (louvain, leiden, label_propagation), and similarity or embedding (node_similarity, fastrp, knn, cosine), plus shortest_path. Extend it with whatever else you run.
algorithm.source: xeo-graph-kit docs/learn/GRAPH-MODEL.md §5 · the published algorithms named in each definition

concepts.label: Betweenness centrality
concepts.definition: Share of shortest paths between other nodes that pass through a node (Freeman, 1977)

concepts.label: Cosine similarity
concepts.definition: Cosine of the angle between two vectors

concepts.label: Degree centrality
concepts.definition: Count of edges touching a node, in a stated orientation

concepts.label: FastRP
concepts.definition: Node embeddings by fast random projection of the adjacency structure (Chen et al., 2019)

concepts.label: k-nearest neighbours
concepts.definition: For each node, the k most similar nodes on a stated property or embedding

concepts.label: Label propagation
concepts.definition: Community detection by iterated neighbour-majority labelling (Raghavan et al., 2007)

concepts.label: Leiden
concepts.definition: Community detection that refines Louvain to guarantee connected communities (Traag et al., 2019)

concepts.label: Louvain
concepts.definition: Community detection by greedy modularity optimisation (Blondel et al., 2008)

concepts.label: Node similarity
concepts.definition: Pairwise similarity from shared neighbours (Jaccard or overlap)

concepts.label: PageRank
concepts.definition: Stationary distribution of a damped random walk over the edges (Brin and Page, 1998)

concepts.label: Shortest path
concepts.definition: Fewest-hop or least-weight path between two nodes (Dijkstra, 1959)

betterDirection.label: Better directions
betterDirection.description: Which way a change in a Metric counts as improvement. Stated once, on the Metric. 'up' and 'down' are the two values xeo:direction took on a target; 'none' is new, for a quantity that is neither good nor bad to have more of.
betterDirection.source: XEO metrics and KPIs research report, 2026-11-10 · if-control-center packages/contracts/src/objective-metric.ts (METRIC_DIRECTIONS), which this generalises

concepts.label: Lower is better
concepts.definition: A decrease is an improvement, as for a position or a rank, where 1 is best

concepts.label: Neither
concepts.definition: More is not better or worse: a sample size, a count of answers collected

concepts.label: Higher is better
concepts.definition: An increase is an improvement

cadence.label: Retainer cadences
cadence.description: The recurring period a retainer's intervention quota resets over. Applies to retainer Projects only.

concepts.label: Monthly
concepts.definition: Quota resets each month

concepts.label: Quarterly

conversionPointType.label: Conversion point types
conversionPointType.description: The kind of mechanism a ConversionPoint is. The first three say with a code what the CallToAction, LeadCaptureForm and GatedAsset subclasses say with a class; the list was growing, and a growing list is a scheme.
conversionPointType.source: XEO CRM pipeline research report, 2026-11-10 · the three ConversionPoint subclasses of xeo-engagement, as codes, with two kinds the report adds

effort.description: How long a Recommendation is expected to take to execute — a categorical horizon, not a score. Scored dimensions (impact, risk, time-to-value) belong on a TacticAssessment via onDimension; this is the delivery-side estimate an operator plans a cycle around.

engagementType.label: Engagement types
engagementType.description: The shape of a Project's contract — the discriminator for how its scope is expressed. A retainer caps interventions per recurring period (cadence); a one-off caps them over a fixed run (durationDays). The intervention quota is common to both and always required: a scope of work with no ceiling is not a scope.

concepts.label: One-off
concepts.definition: Fixed run; the quota covers durationDays

concepts.label: Retainer
concepts.definition: Recurring; the quota resets every cadence period

execution.label: Who executes
execution.description: Who does the work a Recommendation calls for. ours spends the engagement's intervention allowance; advised does not, because advisory work is not agency capacity. This is the delivery-side half of the scope gate: requiresCapability says whether the work is possible, execution says whose hours it costs.

concepts.label: Client does it

concepts.label: We do it

experimentStatus.description: Lifecycle of an Experiment, as xeo:status on that node. unmeasurable covers two arrivals with one word — an operator cleared the measured set, or the website has no search-performance history to measure against; the record says which.

frameworkKind.description: What shape of method a Framework is, which decides how its Stages are read.

gapType.label: Gap types
gapType.description: The kinds of Gap a Diagnostic can reveal, in the priority order the structural comparison states them. Five structural findings, four deep-content axes (a missing FAQ block, a missing spec table, a missing certification and a page written for the wrong buyer stage are four different interventions drawn from different tactic categories), four non-structural findings, and one site-level finding. There is deliberately no backlink value: the referring-domain profile is a separate remit. domain_authority_deficit is not that — it is the finding that the page fight is already winnable and the SITE is what is losing.
gapType.source: if-control-center packages/contracts/src/gap.ts (GAP_TYPES, GAP_TYPE_LABELS, GAP_TYPE_HINTS) · launch-guardian LG_GAP_TYPES

intervention.label: Interventions — the service catalogue
intervention.description: The categories of work an agency can deploy — its service catalogue, as XEO's Intervention taxonomy. A Tactic is inIntervention exactly one of these; a Project's contract scope is expressed over them. Each carries who controls the work (agency, client, or the community) and a typical lead time, because both decide whether a recommendation is deliverable or advisory. The experiment ledger keys the same categories by numeric code; that crosswalk is the ledger's own catalogue, not restated here.

metric.label: Metrics
metric.description: The reference scheme of XEO Metrics: each a definition with a type, a unit, a better direction and an additivity, and what it is computed from. Covers search, AI visibility, website analytics and CRM pipeline, so an Objective can target any of them and a reading means the same thing wherever it is computed. The code a MetricTarget stores in xeo:metric is the skos:notation of a concept here. The six codes published earlier in xeos:objectiveMetric are kept exactly, each with an exactMatch from its old concept, and the two AI rates added there in 0.6.0 match theirs the same way. Definitions are neutral: where vendors use one name for different ratios, the definition here states the denominator, and each vendor's field is mapped to it in mappings/. XEO ships no minDenominator values: it is a slot, and each implementation sets its own. A consumer adds its own Metrics as instances of xeo:Metric in a scheme of its own.
metric.source: XEO metrics and KPIs research report, 2026-11-10 (starter reference scheme) · XEO CRM pipeline research report, 2026-11-10 (pipeline metrics) · the codes of xeos:objectiveMetric, kept unchanged

concepts.editorialNote: A component metric, in neither report's table: added so the ratio that divides by or into it can be computed and rolled up.

concepts.note: reading: a derivation. Whether an answer mentions or cites a brand is extracted from sampled answers, and the sample is a vendor's or a tracker's choice
concepts.editorialNote: A component metric, in neither report's table: added so the ratio that divides by or into it can be computed and rolled up.

concepts.note: reading: a derivation. Whether an answer mentions or cites a brand is extracted from sampled answers, and the sample is a vendor's or a tracker's choice
concepts.editorialNote: A component metric, in neither report's table: added so the ratio that divides by or into it can be computed and rolled up.

concepts.note: reading: a derivation. Whether an answer mentions or cites a brand is extracted from sampled answers, and the sample is a vendor's or a tracker's choice. The property that carries the rollup value is xeo:citationRate

Not ai_citation_share, which divides by citations and not by answers. The implementation sets its minDenominator; XEO ships no value.

concepts.label: AI citation share
concepts.definition: The share of all citations in the sampled answers that point at the brand's owned domains: citations of owned domains divided by all citations
concepts.note: reading: a derivation. Whether an answer mentions or cites a brand is extracted from sampled answers, and the sample is a vendor's or a tracker's choice
concepts.editorialNote: The implementation sets its minDenominator; XEO ships no value.

concepts.label: Citations in AI answers
concepts.definition: The number of citations of any URL across the sampled answers
concepts.note: reading: an observation where the engine annotates its own citations and the tracker counts them
concepts.editorialNote: A component metric, in neither report's table: added so the ratio that divides by or into it can be computed and rolled up.

concepts.label: AI mention rate
concepts.definition: The share of sampled answers that mention the brand: answers mentioning the brand divided by all answers sampled. Every sampled answer is in the denominator, whether or not it names any brand
concepts.note: reading: a derivation. Whether an answer mentions or cites a brand is extracted from sampled answers, and the sample is a vendor's or a tracker's choice. The property that carries the rollup value is xeo:mentionRate
concepts.editorialNote: The report's name, adopted in 0.6.0 (decided 2026-11-12) so every AI visibility code carries the ai_ prefix. What vendors call 'visibility' or 'visibility score' maps here, and not always exactly: see mappings/. The implementation sets its minDenominator; XEO ships no value.

concepts.label: Citations of owned domains
concepts.definition: The number of citations in the sampled answers that point at the brand's owned domains
concepts.note: reading: a derivation. Whether an answer mentions or cites a brand is extracted from sampled answers, and the sample is a vendor's or a tracker's choice
concepts.editorialNote: A component metric, in neither report's table: added so the ratio that divides by or into it can be computed and rolled up.

metric.metricFilter: the cited URL is partOf a Website the brand hasWebsite

concepts.label: AI-referred leads
concepts.definition: Leads created in the window whose first-touch channel is an AI assistant
concepts.note: reading: a derivation. The records are observed in the CRM; the windowed number is computed over them
concepts.editorialNote: From the CRM report only.

concepts.label: AI sentiment score
concepts.definition: A model's score of the tone in which the sampled answers speak of the brand, averaged over the answers that mention it, from 0 to 100
concepts.note: reading: always a derivation, with the scoring model as its method. Not xeo:sentiment, which is a four-way code on one mention
concepts.editorialNote: The implementation sets its minDenominator; XEO ships no value.

concepts.label: AI share of voice
concepts.definition: The brand's share of all tracked-brand mentions in the sampled answers: mentions of the brand divided by mentions of every tracked brand
concepts.note: reading: a derivation. Whether an answer mentions or cites a brand is extracted from sampled answers, and the sample is a vendor's or a tracker's choice
concepts.editorialNote: The implementation sets its minDenominator; XEO ships no value.

concepts.label: Tracked-brand mentions in AI answers
concepts.definition: The number of mentions of any tracked brand, the brand and its named competitors together, across the sampled answers
concepts.note: reading: a derivation. Whether an answer mentions or cites a brand is extracted from sampled answers, and the sample is a vendor's or a tracker's choice
concepts.editorialNote: A component metric, in neither report's table: added so the ratio that divides by or into it can be computed and rolled up. Depends on which brands are tracked: adding a competitor to the set lowers every share computed over it.

metric.metricFilter: the mentioned Brand is the brand or one it competesWith

concepts.label: Clicks
concepts.definition: Search result clicks to the site over the window
concepts.note: reading: an observation where Search Console returned it for exactly this window and scope; a derivation when rolled up or recomputed
concepts.editorialNote: Additive only within one aggregationBasis: clicks counted by page and by property are different counts.

concepts.label: Converting sessions
concepts.definition: Sessions in which at least one key event happened
concepts.note: reading: an observation where the analytics tool returned it for exactly this window and scope; a derivation when rolled up, or when the tool's own channel rule had to be rebuilt
concepts.editorialNote: A component metric, in neither report's table: added so the ratio that divides by or into it can be computed and rolled up.

metric.metricFilter: the session has at least one key event

concepts.label: Clickthrough rate
concepts.definition: The share of impressions that were clicked: clicks divided by impressions, as a 0 to 1 quotient
concepts.note: reading: an observation where Search Console returned it for exactly this window and scope; a derivation when rolled up or recomputed
concepts.editorialNote: The unit is ratio. xeos:objectiveMetric-ctr, its earlier form, noted the unit as percent until 0.6.0 corrected it; Search Console returns a quotient (0.1078), and so does every other source read. The implementation sets its minDenominator; XEO ships no value.

concepts.label: Deals closed
concepts.definition: Deals whose outcome is won or lost and which closed in the window
concepts.note: reading: a derivation. The records are observed in the CRM; the windowed number is computed over them
concepts.editorialNote: A component metric, in neither report's table: added so the ratio that divides by or into it can be computed and rolled up.

concepts.label: Deals created
concepts.definition: Deals the CRM recorded as created in the window
concepts.note: reading: a derivation. The records are observed in the CRM; the windowed number is computed over them
concepts.editorialNote: From the CRM report only.

concepts.label: Deals won
concepts.definition: Deals whose outcome is won and which closed in the window
concepts.note: reading: a derivation. The records are observed in the CRM; the windowed number is computed over them
concepts.editorialNote: The metrics report gives the reading layer as observation; the CRM report says every pipeline number is a derivation over observed records. The second is followed: a count XEO computes over a window is a derivation.

concepts.label: Engaged sessions
concepts.definition: Sessions that met the analytics tool's engagement rule
concepts.note: reading: an observation where the analytics tool returned it for exactly this window and scope; a derivation when rolled up, or when the tool's own channel rule had to be rebuilt

metric.metricFilter: the session meets the tool's engagement rule

concepts.label: Engagement rate
concepts.definition: The share of sessions that were engaged: engaged sessions divided by sessions
concepts.note: reading: an observation where the analytics tool returned it for exactly this window and scope; a derivation when rolled up, or when the tool's own channel rule had to be rebuilt
concepts.editorialNote: Not one minus a bounce rate: one tool's bounce is a single-pageview visit, another's is a session that was not engaged. The implementation sets its minDenominator; XEO ships no value.

concepts.label: Estimated traffic value
concepts.definition: A vendor's modelled value of the site's search traffic over the window
concepts.note: reading: always a derivation, with the vendor's model as its method. It is a model's output, not a measurement
concepts.editorialNote: Layer corrected in 0.6.0: the earlier concept gave it a source and no layer, and it read as a measurement. The currency is the vendor's; a target on it need not state targetCurrency.

concepts.label: Impressions
concepts.definition: Times a result from the site was shown in search over the window
concepts.note: reading: an observation where Search Console returned it for exactly this window and scope; a derivation when rolled up or recomputed
concepts.editorialNote: Additive only within one aggregationBasis.

concepts.label: Key events
concepts.definition: Events the site has marked as conversions, counted over the window
concepts.note: reading: an observation where the analytics tool returned it for exactly this window and scope; a derivation when rolled up, or when the tool's own channel rule had to be rebuilt

concepts.label: Leads created
concepts.definition: Lead or person records the CRM recorded as created in the window
concepts.note: reading: a derivation. The records are observed in the CRM; the windowed number is computed over them
concepts.editorialNote: The metrics report gives the reading layer as observation; the CRM report says every pipeline number is a derivation over observed records. The second is followed: a count XEO computes over a window is a derivation.

concepts.label: Pipeline created
concepts.definition: The summed amount of deals created in the window, in one stated currency
concepts.note: reading: a derivation. The records are observed in the CRM; the windowed number is computed over them
concepts.editorialNote: The metrics report gives the reading layer as observation; the CRM report says every pipeline number is a derivation over observed records. The second is followed: a count XEO computes over a window is a derivation. A target on it states targetCurrency.

concepts.label: Average position
concepts.definition: The average position of the site's results in search over the window, weighted by impressions. 1-based, 1 best
concepts.note: reading: an observation where Search Console returned it for exactly this window and scope; a derivation when rolled up or recomputed
concepts.editorialNote: Depends on aggregationBasis: the source computes it differently by page and by property. The implementation sets its minDenominator; XEO ships no value.

concepts.label: Rank
concepts.definition: The rank of the site's result in a third-party results-page snapshot, read from the latest snapshot in the window. 1-based, 1 best
concepts.note: reading: an observation, from a rank tracker's snapshot

concepts.label: Revenue won
concepts.definition: The summed amount of deals won that closed in the window, in one stated currency
concepts.note: reading: a derivation. The records are observed in the CRM; the windowed number is computed over them
concepts.editorialNote: The metrics report gives the reading layer as observation; the CRM report says every pipeline number is a derivation over observed records. The second is followed: a count XEO computes over a window is a derivation. A target on it states targetCurrency.

concepts.label: Sales cycle
concepts.definition: The median number of days from a deal's creation to its close, over deals won that closed in the window
concepts.note: reading: a derivation. The records are observed in the CRM; the windowed number is computed over them
concepts.editorialNote: From the CRM report only.

concepts.label: Session conversion rate
concepts.definition: The share of sessions in which at least one key event happened: converting sessions divided by sessions
concepts.note: reading: an observation where the analytics tool returned it for exactly this window and scope; a derivation when rolled up, or when the tool's own channel rule had to be rebuilt
concepts.editorialNote: The implementation sets its minDenominator; XEO ships no value.

concepts.label: Sessions
concepts.definition: Visits to the site over the window, by the analytics tool's own session rule
concepts.note: reading: an observation where the analytics tool returned it for exactly this window and scope; a derivation when rolled up, or when the tool's own channel rule had to be rebuilt
concepts.editorialNote: Tools differ on what ends a session, so sessions from two tools are close and not equal.

concepts.label: Win rate
concepts.definition: The share of deals closed in the window that were won: deals won divided by deals won or lost
concepts.note: reading: a derivation. The records are observed in the CRM; the windowed number is computed over them
concepts.editorialNote: From the CRM report only, which gives its unit as percent. Stored as a 0 to 1 quotient like every other ratio. Neither report gives a minimum denominator, so none is stated.

metricType.label: Metric types
metricType.description: How a Metric is computed. The type decides what else the definition must carry: a simple metric names one slot and how to aggregate it; a ratio names a numerator and a denominator; a derived metric names its inputs and the arithmetic over them. cumulative and conversion are here so the typing is complete; the properties they need are in the extension set.
metricType.source: XEO metrics and KPIs research report, 2026-11-10 · the five metric types of dbt MetricFlow, which Cube and LookML express through measure types

concepts.label: Conversion
concepts.definition: The share of an entity's base events that were followed by a conversion event within a window

concepts.label: Cumulative
concepts.definition: A metric accumulated over a trailing window, or from the start of a grain to date

concepts.label: Derived
concepts.definition: Arithmetic over one or more other metrics, stated in expression

concepts.label: Ratio
concepts.definition: One metric divided by another. Rolled up as the sum of numerators over the sum of denominators, never as a mean of ratios

concepts.label: Simple
concepts.definition: One slot, aggregated over the window: a sum, a count, a mean

metricUnit.label: Metric units
metricUnit.description: What a reading of a Metric is a number of. Deliberately few. A rate is a ratio and is stored as a 0 to 1 quotient: every source read returns rates that way, and a percentage is a display format. Distinct from xeos:magnitudeUnit, which names the unit of a Gap's size and includes things that are metrics rather than units.
metricUnit.source: XEO metrics and KPIs research report, 2026-11-10 · the value types of the GA4 Data API (MetricType) and Matomo (metricTypes) · 'days' from the CRM pipeline research report

concepts.label: Count
concepts.definition: A whole number of things: clicks, sessions, deals

concepts.label: Currency
concepts.definition: An amount of money. The reading or target states which, as an ISO 4217 code

concepts.label: Days
concepts.definition: A duration in days, as for the length of a sales cycle

concepts.label: Rank
concepts.definition: A 1-based position, 1 best. An average of ranks is still a rank and may be fractional

concepts.label: Ratio
concepts.definition: A quotient from 0 to 1. Never a percentage: 0.05, not 5

concepts.label: Score, 0 to 100
concepts.definition: A model's score on a 0 to 100 scale. Always a derivation, with the model as its method

concepts.label: Seconds
concepts.definition: A duration in seconds

objectiveMetric.label: Objective metrics
objectiveMetric.description: The metrics a MetricTarget can be set on. Half the vocabulary is lower-is-better — position and rank_absolute are 1-based ranks — so a target's direction is DERIVED from the metric, never client input; a shared +20% across metrics would silently ask for a rank 20% worse. The note on each concept records direction and unit. Since 0.6.0 this is the compatibility list: the six codes published before xeo:Metric existed, plus ai_mention_rate and ai_citation_rate added in 0.6.0, each an exactMatch of its Metric in xeos:metric, which is the full reference scheme and where a target's code resolves.

concepts.label: AI citation rate
concepts.definition: Share of captured responses in the window that cite the brand's owned URLs
concepts.note: direction up · unit ratio · source visibilityFor rollup (xeo:citationRate)

concepts.label: AI mention rate
concepts.definition: Share of captured responses in the window that mention the brand
concepts.note: direction up · unit ratio · source visibilityFor rollup (xeo:mentionRate)

concepts.label: Clicks
concepts.definition: Search clicks over the window
concepts.note: direction up · unit count · source GSC

concepts.label: CTR
concepts.definition: Clickthrough rate over the window
concepts.note: direction up · unit ratio · source GSC
concepts.editorialNote: Until 0.6.0 the note above gave the unit as percent. The sources return a 0 to 1 quotient and xeos:metric-ctr states the unit as ratio, so the note was corrected. A consumer that built on the old note may hold 5 where this means 0.05: check stored ctr targets and baselines before reading them as ratios.

concepts.label: Est. traffic value
concepts.definition: Estimated traffic value
concepts.note: direction up · unit currency · source DataForSEO
concepts.editorialNote: A vendor's model output, so every reading of it is a derivation. xeos:metric-etv says so; this concept's note names only the source.

concepts.label: Impressions
concepts.definition: Search impressions over the window
concepts.note: direction up · unit count · source GSC

concepts.label: Avg position
concepts.definition: Average SERP position over the window
concepts.note: direction down · unit rank · source GSC

concepts.label: Rank
concepts.definition: Absolute rank from a rank tracker
concepts.note: direction down · unit rank · source DataForSEO

organizationKind.label: Organization kinds
organizationKind.description: What kind of party an Organization is.

concepts.label: Agency
concepts.definition: Does the work for clients

concepts.label: Brand
concepts.definition: A company whose sites and brands are worked on, by an agency or by itself

concepts.label: In-house team
concepts.definition: A team inside a company, working on that company's own sites

outcomeResult.label: Outcome results
outcomeResult.description: Whether an Outcome moved. A regression IS significant: result answers did this move, and the lift's sign answers which way. The labels must not smuggle a direction in.

concepts.label: Inconclusive
concepts.definition: Could not be judged — see resultReason

concepts.label: No change
concepts.definition: Measured, and it did not move

concepts.label: Moved
concepts.definition: The measured change clears the significance bar, in either direction

outcomeResultReason.label: Why an outcome was inconclusive
outcomeResultReason.description: Why an Outcome could not be read cleanly. The two confounder reasons read differently on purpose: co_intervention keeps its lift and names the rows it shares attribution with; confounded_external records none. below_volume_floor and no_page_data are not the same sentence — the second asserts an absence, the first says there is data and not yet enough of it.

concepts.label: No search history before this shipped
concepts.definition: Nothing to compare against

concepts.label: Not enough traffic to judge
concepts.definition: There is data, and not yet enough for a rate to mean anything: a reading's denominatorValue is below its Metric's minDenominator

concepts.label: Shared with other work of ours
concepts.definition: Another of our interventions touched the same pages in the window; lift is kept and attribution is shared

concepts.label: Something outside our work changed the page
concepts.definition: An external event confounds the window; no lift is recorded

concepts.label: No search data for this page
concepts.definition: A complete window with no rows at all on the address

concepts.label: Waiting on a reading
concepts.definition: No qualifying rank snapshot has arrived yet

concepts.label: Window still filling
concepts.definition: The results window has not closed

practiceKind.label: Practice kinds
practiceKind.description: How a Practice acts on a candidate recommendation. Kept as a small controlled value rather than a subclass.

concepts.label: Guardrail
concepts.definition: Veto a matching candidate

concepts.label: Guidance
concepts.definition: Attach a caveat; change nothing

concepts.label: Preference
concepts.definition: Reorder a matching candidate

practiceOutcome.label: What a Practice did
practiceOutcome.description: What a Practice did to a candidate when it fired — the value carried on the appliedPractice audit edge. One outcome per practiceKind: a guardrail vetoes, a preference reranks, guidance caveats.

concepts.label: Flagged
concepts.definition: Guidance attached a caveat and changed nothing else

concepts.label: Reordered
concepts.definition: A preference moved the candidate up or down

concepts.label: Blocked
concepts.definition: A guardrail removed the candidate

practiceSource.label: Practice provenance
practiceSource.description: Where a Practice came from — the confidence ratchet. authored stands on a human's authority; claimed ships low-confidence with a halfLife and decays unless experiments promote it; learned is earned from the experiment ledger, and its confidence ratchets with Outcomes. One class holds a firm SOP and a fragile claim without conflating their trust.
practiceSource.source: xeo-strategy.ttl (xeo:source, on a Practice) · if-control-center PRACTICE_SOURCES

concepts.label: Authored
concepts.definition: A human SOP or best-practice — high standing, durable

concepts.label: Claimed
concepts.definition: An unproven assertion — ships low-confidence, decays over its halfLife unless promoted

concepts.label: Learned
concepts.definition: Earned from the experiment ledger; confidence ratchets with Outcomes

practiceStatus.label: Practice lifecycle
practiceStatus.description: Lifecycle of a Practice, as xeo:status on that node. A proposed Practice is visible but does not fire; superseding one deprecates it — retired, never deleted, so the record of what it vetoed survives.
practiceStatus.source: xeo-strategy.ttl (xeo:status, on a Practice) · if-control-center PRACTICE_STATUSES

concepts.label: Proposed
concepts.definition: Visible; does not fire

concepts.label: Active
concepts.definition: Fires on matching candidates

concepts.label: Deprecated
concepts.definition: Superseded; retained for the audit trail

priority.label: Priority tiers
priority.description: The priority a Recommendation is issued at. Three tiers, read as a horizon rather than a severity: now, next, later. Where another system speaks critical/high/medium/low, map critical and high to P0, medium to P1, low to P2 — the mapping is documented here so it is not re-decided per consumer.

concepts.label: Now
concepts.definition: Do this in the current cycle

concepts.label: Next
concepts.definition: Queued behind the current cycle

concepts.label: Later
concepts.definition: Worth doing; not yet scheduled

recommendationStatus.label: Recommendation execution lifecycle
recommendationStatus.description: The execution lifecycle of a Recommendation, as xeo:status on that node. pending, in_progress and blocked are the OPEN states — they still consume an engagement's intervention quota. The delivery board buckets these five into recommended / active / blocked / measuring / completed, where measuring is a completed recommendation still inside its results window; that bucketing is a derived view, not a second vocabulary. A system with a skipped state maps it to cancelled.

concepts.label: Proposed
concepts.definition: Issued and not yet started; counts as open work

concepts.label: In progress
concepts.definition: Being executed; counts as open work

concepts.label: Blocked
concepts.definition: Cannot proceed — a dependency, an approval, or a client direction; still counts as open work

concepts.label: Cancelled
concepts.definition: Withdrawn with a recorded reason; never silently dropped

concepts.label: Done
concepts.definition: Shipped; measuring until its results window closes

recordOrigin.label: Record origins
recordOrigin.description: How a record came to exist in the CRM, as the system recorded it.
recordOrigin.source: XEO CRM pipeline research report, 2026-11-10 (two of seven CRMs keep a system-set origin; the five values are the report's neutral set)

concepts.label: API
concepts.definition: Created through the CRM's API

concepts.label: Form
concepts.definition: Created by a form submission

concepts.label: Import
concepts.definition: Created by a file import

concepts.label: Integration
concepts.definition: Created by a connected product

concepts.label: Manual
concepts.definition: Created by a person in the CRM

searchIntent.label: Search intents
searchIntent.description: Why the person is asking. The same four values xeo-engagement declares as named individuals, published as concepts so that a value is a code and not a term. Each concept is also an xeo:SearchIntent, so targetsIntent may point at it without any change to that property.
searchIntent.source: Broder (2002), 'A taxonomy of web search', as extended in common practice · the four SearchIntent individuals of xeo-engagement, as concepts

concepts.label: Commercial investigation
concepts.definition: The person is comparing options before a purchase

concepts.label: Informational
concepts.definition: The person wants to learn something

concepts.label: Navigational
concepts.definition: The person wants to reach a particular site or page

concepts.label: Transactional
concepts.definition: The person wants to do something now: buy, book, sign up

sentiment.label: Mention sentiment
sentiment.description: The polarity with which a response speaks of a brand. A small reference set, deliberately coarse: a finer scale or a numeric score is a different derivation with its own method. mixed is not the midpoint of the scale; it says the response is both for and against.
sentiment.source: xeo-graph-kit docs/learn/GRAPH-MODEL.md §3 · the four-way polarity common to sentiment classifiers

concepts.label: Mixed
concepts.definition: The response is both favourable and unfavourable

concepts.label: Negative
concepts.definition: The response speaks badly of the brand

concepts.label: Neutral
concepts.definition: The response names the brand without judging it

concepts.label: Positive
concepts.definition: The response speaks well of the brand

serpResultType.label: SERP result types
serpResultType.description: The kinds of result a results page can carry, as stored on hasResult and relatedTerm. The first is the classic ranked listing; the rest are the features that sit around or above it. Two of them (people_also_ask, related_search) are suggested queries and so ride on relatedTerm, pointing at a Term; the others point at a URL. Engines add and retire features, and each provider names them its own way: map a provider's value to one of these, or extend the scheme. A value here says what kind of block the result was shown in, never how prominent it was.
serpResultType.source: xeo-graph-kit docs/learn/GRAPH-MODEL.md §2 (the kit's SERP loader) · result kinds reported in common by SERP data providers

concepts.label: AI overview
concepts.definition: A generated answer shown on the results page; its cited pages are the results

concepts.label: Featured snippet
concepts.definition: An extracted answer shown above the organic results, credited to one page

concepts.label: Image
concepts.definition: A result shown in an image block

concepts.label: Knowledge panel
concepts.definition: A panel about one entity, drawn from the engine's knowledge base

concepts.label: Local pack
concepts.definition: A map-backed block of local business listings

concepts.label: Organic result
concepts.definition: A standard ranked web result

concepts.label: Paid
concepts.definition: An advertisement

concepts.label: People also ask
concepts.definition: A related question shown in an expandable question box

concepts.label: Related search
concepts.definition: A query the engine suggests alongside the results

concepts.label: Shopping
concepts.definition: A product listing shown in a shopping block

concepts.label: Top stories
concepts.definition: A result shown in a news block

concepts.label: Video
concepts.definition: A result shown in a video block or carousel

similarityBasis.label: Similarity bases
similarityBasis.description: What was compared to produce a similarity. Carried on every similarTo edge, because two pages can be near on one basis and far on another, and a similarity that does not name its basis cannot be read. Similarities on different bases are not comparable.

concepts.label: Lexical
concepts.definition: Overlap in surface strings: tokens, n-grams, edit distance

concepts.label: Links
concepts.definition: Overlap in what the two link to or are linked from

concepts.label: Shared terms
concepts.definition: Overlap in the Terms the two rank for or belong to

concepts.label: Structural embedding
concepts.definition: Distance between node embeddings computed from graph structure

concepts.label: Text embedding
concepts.definition: Distance between embeddings of the two texts

stageSlot.label: Stage slots
stageSlot.description: Which of a record's staged properties a StageTransition records a move in.
stageSlot.source: XEO CRM pipeline research report, 2026-11-10 (StageTransition term card; codes in snake_case to match every other XEO code)

concepts.label: Deal stage
concepts.definition: The stage of a deal in its pipeline

concepts.label: Lead status
concepts.definition: The sales working state of a lead

concepts.label: Lifecycle stage
concepts.definition: The funnel position of a person or organization

targetKind.label: Target kinds
targetKind.description: How a MetricTarget's targetValue is read: as an absolute value of the metric, or as a percent change from the captured baseline. Since 0.6.0 also as a relative change written as a quotient, or as an absolute change from baseline in the metric's unit.

concepts.label: Absolute
concepts.definition: targetValue is a value of the metric itself

concepts.label: Absolute change
concepts.definition: targetValue is a change from baseline in the metric's own unit, in its better direction. For a ratio this is points: 0.02 on a clickthrough rate is two points

concepts.label: Percent lift
concepts.definition: targetValue is a relative change from baseline, in the metric's better direction

concepts.label: Relative change
concepts.definition: targetValue is a relative change from baseline in the metric's better direction, written as a quotient: 0.2 is a fifth more than baseline
concepts.editorialNote: closeMatch, not exactMatch, to percent: whether a stored percent target holds 20 or 0.2 for a fifth is each consumer's convention, and the ontology never said.

timeGrain.label: Time grains
timeGrain.description: The calendar grains a cumulative Metric can reset at.
timeGrain.source: XEO metrics and KPIs research report, 2026-11-10 · dbt (grain_to_date, time_granularity), Cube (granularity)

concepts.label: Day
concepts.definition: Resets each day

concepts.label: Month
concepts.definition: Resets each month: a month-to-date total

concepts.label: Quarter
concepts.definition: Resets each quarter

concepts.label: Week
concepts.definition: Resets each week

concepts.label: Year
concepts.definition: Resets each year

valuePeriod.label: Value periods
valuePeriod.description: The period a recurringValue recurs over.
valuePeriod.source: XEO CRM pipeline research report, 2026-11-10 (three of seven CRMs record a recurring value). The three codes are inferred for XEO from the fields those CRMs expose (a one-time value, a monthly and an annual recurring value); no vendor's list is adopted

concepts.label: Annual
concepts.definition: Recurs each year

concepts.label: Monthly
concepts.definition: Recurs each month

concepts.label: One-time
concepts.definition: Not recurring

xeoLayer.label: Layers
xeoLayer.description: The six kinds of claim an XEO term can make, in order from bedrock to governance. The annotation property types TERMS; publishing the six here as a scheme gives a consumer tagging INSTANCES the same six values under one IRI each. A graph that stamps instances with their layer uses the same name, xeoLayer, and these six values. Named epistemicLayer until 0.7.

concepts.label: Entity
concepts.definition: A durable identity — a website, a page, a term, a brand

concepts.label: Episode
concepts.definition: Something that happened at a time; immutable once finished — a crawl, a captured response, an experiment

concepts.label: Observation
concepts.definition: A measured fact, grounded in a standard or an API contract

concepts.label: Derivation
concepts.definition: Model or algorithm output; carries method, model and confidence

concepts.label: Interpretation
concepts.definition: A labeled claim — a diagnosed gap, a recommendation, an objective

concepts.label: Norm
concepts.definition: A standing rule about a class of cases — a Practice

ga4.label: Google Analytics 4 Data API
ga4.description: The request and response fields of runReport, and the predefined metrics a site's readings are most often taken from, mapped to the Metrics in xeos:metric. GA4 has no native AI-assistant metric the report could confirm in Google's own documentation, so ai_assistant_sessions has no concept here.
ga4.source: XEO metrics and KPIs research report, 2026-11-10, Appendix C · https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/reporting/data/v1 · https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/google-analytics-4-transformation (the api-schema page returned navigation only; metric definitions come from adjacent official pages)

concepts.label: Bounce rate
concepts.definition: Sessions that were not engaged, divided by sessions
concepts.scopeNote: One minus engagementRate. Related, not a match: it runs the other way, and it is not what other tools call a bounce (a single-pageview visit).
concepts.source: https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/reporting/data/v1 and the adjacent official pages the report lists; the api-schema page itself returned navigation only (read 2026-11-10)

concepts.label: Date ranges
concepts.definition: The windows the report is run over, each with a startDate and an endDate
concepts.scopeNote: Request field. Two ranges in one request is how GA4 does a period-over-period comparison: the second is the baseline window.

concepts.label: Engaged sessions
concepts.definition: Sessions that lasted longer than 10 seconds, or had a key event, or had 2 or more views
concepts.scopeNote: The engagement rule is GA4's; it is the rule the neutral metric defers to for a GA4 reading.
concepts.source: https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/reporting/data/v1 and the adjacent official pages the report lists; the api-schema page itself returned navigation only (read 2026-11-10)

concepts.label: Engagement rate
concepts.definition: Engaged sessions divided by sessions
concepts.scopeNote: Returned as a fraction, 0 to 1.

concepts.label: Key events
concepts.definition: The count of events marked as key events
concepts.scopeNote: Formerly 'conversions'; the rename is reported by a secondary source. A per-event variant is written keyEvents:<event name>.
concepts.source: https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/reporting/data/v1 and the adjacent official pages the report lists; the api-schema page itself returned navigation only (read 2026-11-10)

concepts.label: Metric type
concepts.definition: The value type of a returned metric: TYPE_INTEGER, TYPE_FLOAT, TYPE_SECONDS, TYPE_CURRENCY and others
concepts.scopeNote: Response field. A value type, coarser than a unit: TYPE_FLOAT covers ratios and averages alike.

concepts.label: Metric expression
concepts.definition: A mathematical expression over other metrics, defining a derived metric in the request
concepts.scopeNote: Request field. Its presence makes the requested metric a derived one.

concepts.label: Organic Google Search clicks
concepts.definition: Search Console clicks, reported inside GA4
concepts.scopeNote: Search Console's number seen through GA4, not a second measurement.
concepts.source: https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/reporting/data/v1 and the adjacent official pages the report lists; the api-schema page itself returned navigation only (read 2026-11-10)

concepts.label: Metric value
concepts.definition: The value of one metric in one row, as a string
concepts.scopeNote: Response field. A string, to be parsed as a number.

concepts.label: Session key event rate
concepts.definition: The share of sessions in which a key event happened
concepts.scopeNote: A fraction, 0 to 1.
concepts.source: https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/reporting/data/v1 and the adjacent official pages the report lists; the api-schema page itself returned navigation only (read 2026-11-10)

concepts.label: Sessions
concepts.definition: The number of sessions that began on the site
concepts.scopeNote: A session starts with a session_start event. closeMatch: other tools end a session by a different rule, so counts are near and not equal.
concepts.source: https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/reporting/data/v1 and the adjacent official pages the report lists; the api-schema page itself returned navigation only (read 2026-11-10)

gsc.label: Google Search Console Search Analytics API
gsc.description: The request and response fields of searchAnalytics.query, mapped to the Metrics they are readings of and to the reading's own slots. The four response metrics are the ground truth core's ranksFor rollup is built from.
gsc.source: XEO metrics and KPIs research report, 2026-11-10, Appendix C · https://developers.google.com/webmaster-tools/v1/how-tos/all-your-data (read from a search extract of the page, not the full page)

concepts.label: Aggregation type
concepts.definition: How results were deduplicated: auto, byPage or byProperty
concepts.scopeNote: auto -> auto, byPage -> by_page, byProperty -> by_property.

concepts.label: Clicks
concepts.definition: Clicks on the site's results for the row
concepts.scopeNote: A double. The count differs by aggregationType: by page and by property are two different numbers under this one field.

concepts.label: CTR
concepts.definition: Clicks divided by impressions for the row
concepts.scopeNote: Returned as a 0 to 1 quotient (0.1078), not a percentage. clicks and impressions of the same row are its numeratorValue and denominatorValue.

concepts.label: Dimension filter groups
concepts.definition: Filters on page, query, country, device or search appearance applied to the request
concepts.scopeNote: Restricts every metric in the row alike, which makes it scope and not a metricFilter.

concepts.label: End date
concepts.definition: The last day of the requested range
concepts.scopeNote: Request field.

concepts.label: Impressions
concepts.definition: Times the site's results were shown for the row
concepts.scopeNote: A double. Differs by aggregationType, like clicks.

concepts.label: Position
concepts.definition: The average position of the site's results for the row
concepts.scopeNote: 1-based, an average over impressions, and computed differently when results are grouped by page than by property. Never summed.

concepts.label: Start date
concepts.definition: The first day of the requested range
concepts.scopeNote: Request field.

hubspotCrm.label: HubSpot CRM properties
hubspotCrm.description: HubSpot's deal and contact properties, by internal name, mapped to the XEO pipeline slots. Stage and pipeline ids are not here and cannot be: they are configured per portal, so the same stage has a different id in every account, and they are mapped per tenant through stageClass. Check the internal names marked inferred against GET /crm/properties/2026-09/deals and /contacts on a live portal before relying on them.
hubspotCrm.source: XEO CRM pipeline research report, 2026-11-10, Appendix B · HubSpot Knowledge Base and developer documentation as cited on each concept

concepts.label: AI Referrals (traffic source value)
concepts.definition: A visit HubSpot classified as referred by an AI platform
concepts.scopeNote: A value of the original and latest traffic source properties, not a property. A visit qualifies when the referring domain, or a UTM parameter, is one of the AI platform domains HubSpot recognises (chatgpt.com, claude.ai, perplexity.ai, copilot.microsoft.com, gemini.google.com, meta.ai, mistral.ai, poe.com, grok.com); HubSpot states that only AI-specific domains like gemini.google.com are categorised this way. History is not reclassified. closeMatch because another tool's list of assistants differs. A community report shows a UTM can send such a visit to OTHER_CAMPAIGNS instead.
concepts.source: HubSpot Knowledge Base, traffic source properties (knowledge.hubspot.com; the report records the page and not its URL) (read 2026-11-10)

concepts.label: Amount
concepts.definition: The total value of the deal, in the deal's currency
concepts.scopeNote: The deal's own currency. Not amount_in_home_currency, which is converted, and not hs_forecast_amount, which is weighted.

concepts.label: Amount in company currency
concepts.definition: The deal amount converted to the account's company currency
concepts.scopeNote: Converted at the latest account rate while the deal is open, and at the rate in effect on the close date once it is closed. The definition is documented; the internal name was confirmed only from HubSpot Community API responses.

concepts.label: Close date
concepts.definition: The day the deal is expected to close, or was closed
concepts.scopeNote: One field, two meanings: route by outcome. While the deal is open it is the owner's forecast (expectedCloseDate); once closed it is when it closed (dealClosedAt). HubSpot sets it to today when a deal moves into a closed stage, but not when only the stage property is updated through the API, so a closed deal can carry a stale forecast date.

concepts.label: Create date
concepts.definition: When the deal was created
concepts.scopeNote: Users can edit a deal's create date by hand, so it is the CRM's record of creation and not proof of it.

concepts.label: Deal stage
concepts.definition: The stage the deal is in, as the portal's internal stage id
concepts.scopeNote: The value is a per-portal id ('closedwon' in one account, '258551227' in another). What the stage means is read from the pipelines API's stage metadata, per tenant, and goes in stageClass.

concepts.label: Latest traffic source
concepts.definition: The channel of the contact's most recent session, as HubSpot's classifier assigned it
concepts.scopeNote: Same values and classifier as the original source. The definition is documented; the internal name was confirmed only from HubSpot Community API responses.
concepts.source: HubSpot Knowledge Base, traffic source properties (knowledge.hubspot.com; the report records the page and not its URL) (read 2026-11-10)

concepts.label: Original traffic source
concepts.definition: The channel of the contact's earliest known session, as HubSpot's classifier assigned it
concepts.scopeNote: A vendor classifier's output: method vendor-classifier:hubspot. Values ORGANIC_SEARCH, PAID_SEARCH, EMAIL_MARKETING, SOCIAL_MEDIA, REFERRALS, OTHER_CAMPAIGNS, DIRECT_TRAFFIC, OFFLINE, PAID_SOCIAL, AI_REFERRALS; only the last is mapped to a neutral channel so far. A deal inherits it from the associated contact with the earliest activity. The definition is documented; the internal name was confirmed only from HubSpot Community API responses.
concepts.source: HubSpot Knowledge Base, traffic source properties (knowledge.hubspot.com; the report records the page and not its URL) (read 2026-11-10)

concepts.label: Forecast amount
concepts.definition: The deal amount multiplied by its forecast probability
concepts.scopeNote: Weighted by the forecast probability, which is not the deal probability; HubSpot's 'Weighted amount' uses the latter and is the one it recommends. Method must name which.

concepts.label: Is closed won
concepts.definition: True when the deal is in a closed-won stage
concepts.scopeNote: Answers won or not won, and nothing about lost. Lost is derived from the stage's closed flag in the pipelines metadata, with method tenant-stage-map.

concepts.label: Date entered stage (v2)
concepts.definition: When the deal most recently entered a given stage; one property per stage, named by appending the stage id
concepts.scopeNote: The notation is a prefix: the property is hs_v2_date_entered_<stage id>. Holds the latest entry only, so it yields one StageTransition per stage and not the full history. Never use the legacy hs_date_entered_ properties: they cleared when a deal moved backwards and filled when it skipped a stage, and stopped being returned on 2024-11-20.
concepts.source: HubSpot Developer Changelog, sunset of the legacy stage properties (developers.hubspot.com; the report records the page and not its URL) (read 2026-11-10)

concepts.label: Deal owner
concepts.definition: The user the deal is assigned to
concepts.scopeNote: An owner id. Not the user who created the record.

concepts.label: Lifecycle stage
concepts.definition: Where the contact or company is in the marketing and sales funnel
concepts.scopeNote: Default values subscriber, lead, marketingqualifiedlead, salesqualifiedlead, opportunity, customer, evangelist; a portal can customize the ladder, and the one the report saw had. The API moves a record forward only. What qualifies a lead for each stage is the portal's own rule.
concepts.source: HubSpot Knowledge Base, default contact properties (knowledge.hubspot.com; the report records the page and not its URL) (read 2026-11-10)

concepts.label: Pipeline
concepts.definition: The pipeline the deal is in, as the portal's internal pipeline id
concepts.scopeNote: A per-portal id; the report's example value is 'default'.

peec.label: Peec AI Customer API (brands report)
peec.description: The fields of Peec's brands report, mapped to the AI visibility Metrics. Peec publishes its aggregation formulas and the components behind each rate, which is why most of these are exact. Compare with xeos:profound: the two vendors use 'visibility' for ratios with different denominators.
peec.source: XEO metrics and KPIs research report, 2026-11-10, Appendix C and section 6 · https://docs.peec.ai/api-reference/reports/get-brands-report

concepts.label: End date
concepts.definition: The last day of the requested window
concepts.scopeNote: Request field.

concepts.label: Filters
concepts.definition: Conditions applied before aggregation
concepts.scopeNote: Shrinks numerator and denominator alike, which is scope. The sibling request field 'having' filters after aggregation and is neither scope nor a metricFilter.

concepts.label: Mention count
concepts.definition: The number of mentions of the brand
concepts.scopeNote: Taken as the numerator of share_of_voice. The report lists it among the rollup components and quotes no formula that uses it, so the role is a reading.

concepts.label: Position
concepts.definition: The brand's average rank among the brands a chat names, over chats where it appears
concepts.scopeNote: sum(position_sum) / sum(position_count). Averaged only over chats where the brand appears. 1 is best.

concepts.label: Position count
concepts.definition: The number of chats in which the brand appears with a position
concepts.scopeNote: The denominator of position; compare it with the Metric's minDenominator.

concepts.label: Position sum
concepts.definition: The sum of the brand's positions over the chats where it appears
concepts.scopeNote: The numerator of position.

concepts.label: Previous end date
concepts.definition: The last day of the comparison window
concepts.scopeNote: See previous_start_date.

concepts.label: Previous start date
concepts.definition: The first day of the comparison window
concepts.scopeNote: With previous_end_date, the window of the baseline reading. Left out, Peec uses the window of equal length immediately before start_date.

concepts.label: Sentiment
concepts.definition: A model's score of the tone of the brand's mentions, 0 to 100
concepts.scopeNote: A vendor model's output: a derivation with Peec as its method. Not xeo:sentiment, which is a four-way code on one mention.

concepts.label: Share of voice
concepts.definition: The brand's mentions as a share of all tracked brands' mentions
concepts.scopeNote: 0 to 1. A pre-aggregation filter on one brand shrinks numerator and denominator together and collapses this to 1.0; filter with 'having' instead.

concepts.label: Start date
concepts.definition: The first day of the requested window
concepts.scopeNote: Request field.

concepts.label: Visibility
concepts.definition: The share of chats in which the brand was mentioned
concepts.scopeNote: sum(visibility_count) / sum(visibility_total), over all chats; 0 to 1. Peec's Data Studio connector has a field of the same name defined as a count of chats; that one is not this.

concepts.label: Visibility count
concepts.definition: The number of chats in which the brand was mentioned
concepts.scopeNote: The numerator of visibility; as a count in its own right it is a reading of ai_answers_mentioning.

concepts.label: Visibility total
concepts.definition: The number of chats the rate was computed over
concepts.scopeNote: The denominator of visibility, and of win_rate; as a count in its own right it is a reading of ai_answers_sampled.

profound.label: Profound External API (visibility and citations reports)
profound.description: The fields of Profound's visibility and citations reports, mapped to the AI visibility Metrics. Two warnings a classifier needs. Profound's own pages disagree on the denominator of visibility_score. And share_of_voice is one field name with two meanings, depending on the report it is returned by.
profound.source: XEO metrics and KPIs research report, 2026-11-10, Appendix C and section 6 · https://docs.tryprofound.com/api-reference/reports/query-visibility · https://docs.tryprofound.com/api-reference/reports/query-citations (OpenAPI v0.60.2) · https://help.tryprofound.com/articles/3443229936-answer-engine-insights-overview

concepts.label: Citation share
concepts.definition: Citations of an item as a share of all citations
concepts.scopeNote: In the citations report. Replaces that report's share_of_voice.

concepts.label: End date
concepts.definition: The last day of the requested window
concepts.scopeNote: Request field.

concepts.label: Executions
concepts.definition: The number of prompt runs analysed
concepts.scopeNote: The sample size behind the visibility report's rates.

concepts.label: Filters
concepts.definition: Conditions that restrict the report
concepts.scopeNote: Request field.

concepts.label: Mentions count
concepts.definition: The number of mentions analysed
concepts.scopeNote: A numerator behind the visibility report's rates. The report does not say of which rate.

concepts.label: Metrics
concepts.definition: The metrics the report is asked to return
concepts.scopeNote: Request field: each name selects one Metric.

concepts.label: Share of voice (citations report, deprecated)
concepts.definition: Citations of an item as a share of all citations
concepts.scopeNote: In the citations report, where Profound has deprecated it in favour of citation_share. Citation-based, and so not the mention-based share_of_voice of the visibility report.

concepts.label: Share of voice (visibility report)
concepts.definition: The brand's mentions as a share of all mentions
concepts.scopeNote: In the visibility report only. The citations report returns a field of the same name that means something else.

concepts.label: Start date
concepts.definition: The first day of the requested window
concepts.scopeNote: Request field. Profound returns no comparison window; a change is computed by the client from two requests.

concepts.label: Visibility score
concepts.definition: The share of responses that include the brand
concepts.scopeNote: A raw decimal, 0 to 1; multiply by 100 to display. The denominator conflicts between Profound's own pages: the help center divides by responses that name at least one brand, the glossary example by all tracked responses. On the first reading it runs higher than ai_mention_rate whenever few answers name any brand. closeMatch until live output settles which.
